Figure_S_localization_effects.description: Exploratory localization study of the spike simulations (one event per location and condition: 24 locations, focal dipoles and 10-mm patches at 80 and 320 nAm; inverse with a 1-layer BEM (the simulation used 3 layers) and a 2-mm / 2-degree coregistration error shared by all systems). Each point is the stored paired statistic of g4_localization*_summary.json paired[...]: the median over the condition's events of the OPM array's error minus Neuromag's (all channels), with the stored 95 % bootstrap interval over events (2,000 resamples, docs/methods.md IC-BOOT-LOC) and the uncorrected Wilcoxon signed-rank p. Panels: rows = strength, columns = inverse method (equivalent current dipole; dSPM peak through MNE-Python; dSPM peak through the study's implementation); rows within a panel = the nine anatomies (style.ANAT_ORDER), four estimates each (dense array above the site-matched one; circle focal, square patch). The errors are read at the true peak sample for every event, detected or not; the marker fill is derived from the per-event tables: filled when both systems detected at least half of the 24 paired events (practical detector, thresholds frozen at 1 false event per minute), open otherwise. Stars (beside the interval: left, or right where a neighbouring marker is in the way): * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.0025 (0.05 / 20: 4 conditions x 5 endpoints per anatomy and OPM array, the within-anatomy-and-array Bonferroni family of the text). The x axis differs between strengths and between the dipole and the dSPM columns (limits: 320nAm/ecd -6.0 to 6.0 mm, 320nAm/dspm -20.9 to 10.0 mm, 80nAm/ecd -17.4 to 15.0 mm, 80nAm/dspm -63.2 to 20.0 mm). Checks: the per-event tables reproduce every stored detection share, joint share, discordant count, median difference and share with the OPM closer that the figure uses (1008 values). Selection and censoring: the paired statistics drawn include every event (no selection by detection), whereas the stored per-system medians among detected events (results[...].*_median_detected) are selected by each system's own detections and are not drawn; every event has a dipole and a dSPM error (docs/methods.md section 9: the dipole fit returned a dipole for every event), so no error is censored and gross errors are included. Neuromag's magnetometers or gradiometers alone (secondary comparators, paired_secondary) are not drawn. The localization summaries hold no depth-band split (6 locations per band would be too few), so depth is not drawn.
Figure_S_localization_effects.alt: Six forest plots (two strengths by three inverse methods) of the median paired localization-error difference, OPM array minus Neuromag, for nine anatomies and two OPM arrays. At 320 nAm the dipole-fit differences range from −1.8 to +1.7 mm with every interval within 5 mm of zero, and the dSPM differences from −8.7 to 0.0 mm. At 80 nAm, where most events go undetected (open markers), the dipole differences range from −6.5 to +3.5 mm and the dSPM differences from −33.3 to +3.1 mm, with wide intervals.
Figure_S_localization_effects.caption_draft: Localization effect sizes, OPM array minus Neuromag (306 channels), paired on identical simulated spikes (median over the 24 events of a condition, 95 % bootstrap interval over events; negative: the OPM array localizes closer to the true source). Dark blue: dense OPM array; light blue: site-matched OPM array; circles: focal dipoles; squares: 10-mm patches; open markers: fewer than half of the events detected by both systems. (a–c) 320 nAm: dipole-fit differences −1.8 to +1.7 mm; dSPM differences −8.7 to 0.0 mm. (d–f) 80 nAm: all 108 estimates rest mostly on undetected events; dipole −6.5 to +3.5 mm, dSPM −33.3 to +3.1 mm. Of the 216 error comparisons, 54 have p < 0.05 (Wilcoxon, uncorrected; dipole fit 6, MNE-Python's dSPM 27, the study's dSPM 21), 24 of them with fewer than half of the events detected by both systems, and 8 fall below 0.0025 (Bonferroni within anatomy and OPM array): School-age size (scaled adult), dense array, focal 320 nAm, the study's dSPM −7.0 mm (p = 0.0002); 18-month template, site-matched array, focal 320 nAm, the study's dSPM −4.8 mm (p = 0.0019); 18-month template, dense array, patch 80 nAm, dipole fit −4.3 mm (p = 0.002); 18-month template, site-matched array, patch 80 nAm, MNE-Python's dSPM −16.7 mm (p = 0.0017); 12-month template, dense array, focal 80 nAm, MNE-Python's dSPM −11.9 mm (p = 0.0017); 12-month template, site-matched array, focal 80 nAm, MNE-Python's dSPM −18.4 mm (p = 0.00043); 12-month template, site-matched array, patch 80 nAm, MNE-Python's dSPM −26.8 mm (p = 0.0021); 12-month template, site-matched array, patch 80 nAm, the study's dSPM −33.3 mm (p = 0.00018). 20 medians are exactly zero (tied dSPM peaks on the shared grid) and 30 are positive. The errors include every event, detected or not; localization is read at the true peak sample.

Figure_S_joint_detection_localization.description: Joint detection and localization in the exploratory localization study. For each anatomy (rows), system (Neuromag with all channels, dense OPM array, site-matched OPM array) and condition (columns: focal dipole or 10-mm patch at 320 and 80 nAm), the bar length is the stored share of the 24 injected events detected by the practical detector (results[...].detected) and its dark part the stored share detected and localized within 10 mm (results[...].joint_detect_and_<method>_within_10mm; rows of panels: dipole fit, dSPM with MNE-Python, dSPM with the study's implementation). Both shares have the injected events as their denominator, so neither is conditioned on detection; the pale part is the share detected but localized more than 10 mm away, the rest to 100 % the share missed. Stars: the stored exact McNemar p of the paired OPM minus Neuromag joint-success endpoint (dipole fit and study's dSPM only; none is stored for MNE-Python's dSPM) below 0.05, uncorrected. Localization is read at the true peak sample (oracle timing). Neuromag's magnetometers or gradiometers alone (secondary comparators) are not drawn. The per-event tables reproduce every share and discordant count drawn.
Figure_S_joint_detection_localization.alt: Twelve small bar charts: three inverse methods by four conditions, nine anatomies each with three bars (Neuromag, dense OPM, site-matched OPM). At 320 nAm the systems detect 50–100 % of the events; the share also localized within 10 mm is, for the dipole fit, Neuromag 29–83 %; dense 33–79 %; site-matched 33–75 %; for MNE-Python's dSPM Neuromag 4–46 %; dense 21–67 %; site-matched 21–67 %. At 80 nAm detection falls to 4–54 % and joint success with it.
Figure_S_joint_detection_localization.caption_draft: Joint detection and localization of the simulated spikes. Bar length: share of the 24 injected events per condition detected by the practical detector (thresholds frozen at 1 false event per minute); dark part: detected and localized within 10 mm by (a) the dipole fit, (b) dSPM through MNE-Python, (c) dSPM through the study's implementation. At 320 nAm the systems detect 50–100 % of the events; detected and localized within 10 mm: with the dipole fit Neuromag 29–83 %; dense 33–79 %; site-matched 33–75 %; with MNE-Python's dSPM Neuromag 4–46 %; dense 21–67 %; site-matched 21–67 %. At 80 nAm they detect 4–54 %, which bounds joint success. Of the 72 paired joint-success comparisons per method, 0 (dipole fit) and 11 (study's dSPM; 4 of them at 80 nAm) have p < 0.05 (exact McNemar, uncorrected), all favouring the OPM array. Localization is read at the true peak sample, so joint success assumes the event time is known.

Figure_S_detection_curves_adult.description: Clean redraw of results/g4/Figure_G4_detection.png (exploratory run, simulated at ed852b2, seed 44): the adult's stored detection probability of focal events (three morphologies pooled) per strength, depth band and detector, with the stored Wilson 95 % intervals (recomputed here from the stored n and p for all 240 points: identical). Columns: depth bands from docs/methods.md section 9, checked against the stored location depths (18 locations per band, 54 events per point). Rows: oracle detector (knows source, waveform and peak time; per-trial false-positive probability 0.001) and practical detector at 1 false event per minute (thresholds from 20 min of null data, frozen; held-out rates over 20 min in the footnote). Solid lines with bands: Neuromag (all channels), dense and site-matched OPM arrays; grey lines without bands: Neuromag's gradiometers (dashed) or magnetometers (dotted) alone (secondary comparators). The bands treat each point's events as independent; the events share locations, so they are descriptive (docs/methods.md section 9). The stored S50 values (location bootstrap) are listed in values, not drawn.
Figure_S_detection_curves_adult.alt: Eight line charts of detection probability against focal spike strength from 10 to 320 nAm on a log axis, for four depth bands (columns) and two detectors (rows). Curves rise from 0 to near 1 and shift to higher strengths with depth. At 10–20 mm the practical detector reaches 50 % at about 34 nAm with the dense OPM array, 40 nAm with the site-matched array and 47 nAm with Neuromag, 1.8–2.1 times the oracle's strengths; in the deepest band it detects 0.50 to 0.67 of the 320-nAm events.
Figure_S_detection_curves_adult.caption_draft: Detection of simulated spikes in the adult, exploratory run: probability of detecting a focal spike (54 events per point: 18 locations x 3 morphologies) against its strength, per depth band, for (a) the oracle detector and (b) the practical detector (thresholds frozen at 1 false event per minute). Shaded: Wilson 95 % intervals at the event level, descriptive only (the events of a point share locations; the paired comparisons treat the location as the unit). The strength for 50 % detection at 10–20 mm is 16, 22 and 25 nAm with the oracle and 34, 40 and 47 nAm with the practical detector (dense OPM, site-matched OPM, Neuromag).
